answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 18734 Country: India Title: My question is about distribution of assets (movable and immovable) inherited from parents. I have 04 sisters and One of them is not normal mentally. I am the only son of my parents. Kindly advice what percentage should go to whom. Question: AsSalaamA'laikom, My question is about distribution of assets (movable and immovable) inherited from parents. I have 04 sisters and One of them is not normal mentally. I am the only son of my parents. Kindly advice what percentage should goto whom. Answer ID: 18734 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 86/86=B=1431) According to Shariah, all the property and wealth of your parents will be distributed in 6 shares; out of which you will get two shares and each sister will get 1-1 share. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
